title: Henguard Worm Defense, All-Natural Poultry Cleanse & Parasite Prevention
description:
• Keep Your Flock Healthy, Naturally.

    Give your birds the gift of a clean digestive system without the use of harsh chemicals. HenGuard Worm Defense is a premium, all-natural herbal blend designed to support intestinal health and create an environment that naturally discourages parasites.

    Why Choose HenGuard?

    • ALL-NATURAL DEWORMING SUPPORT: A powerful blend of papaya seeds and pumpkin seeds (nature’s top defenses) combined with oregano, thyme, and garlic for a complete poultry cleanse.

    • NO EGG WITHDRAWAL: Because this formula is 100% natural and herbal, there is no need to throw away eggs during or after use!

    • DIGESTIVE VITALITY: Beyond parasite prevention, our herbal blend supports overall gut health, helping your chickens, ducks, and turkeys absorb nutrients more effectively.

    • TRUE 100% USA GROWN: Don't be fooled by "Made in the USA" labels. While competitors import cheap bulk herbs and simply mix them stateside, then claim "Made in the USA".  We grow our own. From our Midwest family farm to Florida-grown papaya seeds, every single ingredient is raised on American soil using organic methods for total quality control.

    • THERAPEUTIC-GRADE HERBS: These aren’t just "kitchen spices." We cultivate heirloom herb varieties specifically for their high medicinal content and health benefits. While other brands use low-potency culinary imports, our herbs are grown to a therapeutic standard to ensure your flock receives the maximum biological support they deserve.

    • EASY TO FEED: No messy water additives. Simply mix it into their daily feed or offer it as a healthy treat.

    Product Details:

    • Size: 1 lb (16 oz) or 12oz sizes - Resealable Pouch

    • Ingredients: Pumpkin seeds, Papaya seeds, Garlic, Oregano, Thyme.

    • Suitable for: Chickens, Ducks, Turkeys, and all domestic poultry.

description:
